g.text: Defensibility: a wrapper around a model is not a moat
what a customer would miss if the vendor vanished
so a wrapper is not a moat
What is left that a customer would
miss? If only the prompt, the moat
an existing user base or channel
sits in the system of record
slow to copy in regulated or
a lower cost per task lets you
price below rivals and earn margin
Bloomberg: data and the Terminal workflow, not the model
distribution slows rivals; it does not stop a better workflow
